title: FeaturePlanCommand
responsibility: Register a CLI for inspecting, selecting and approving feature plans.

inputs.name: constructor.dependencies
inputs.description: Tests inject structural collaborators; defaults are real feature plan repository, validator and readiness adapter.

inputs.name: plan commands
inputs.description: All commands support --json. Human output includes design choices, selection, module tree and wanted contracts.

outputs.name: register
outputs.description: Registers the plan draft, show, select and approve child commands. Human output shows options, selection, preferred option, parent module tree and wanted contracts; --json emits structured plans.

errors.name: invalid command or plan
errors.description: Missing plan, malformed JSON, invalid selection, stale digest and readiness failures propagate without claiming success.
